title: Backups that aren't really backups: a seven-point audit
lede: An agency lead sent a Loom at 23:41: the restore file was 11 MB, the database is 4.7 GB. Here's how that happens, and how to make sure it doesn't to you.
hero_alt: Antique brass balance scale on scarred oak, one pan holding a cream envelope with clay-red wax seal.
